# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

## From iteration cand_0001
- **Surface the reward basis to the optimizer up front.** The single most decision-changing
  fact for this task — reward = DB × COMMUNICATE with ACTION UNSCORED — was not in
  INSTRUCTIONS.md or any guidance file; I had to derive it by reading the tau2 evaluator
  source (evaluator.py, evaluator_communicate.py, data_model/tasks.py). Every tau2 tools
  run would benefit from INSTRUCTIONS (or a generated pre-brief) stating each task's
  `reward_basis` and one line on what each component checks. Without it, an optimizer is
  likely to waste iterations "fixing" the agent's tool-call arguments, which do not affect
  the score at all when ACTION is out of basis.
- **Provide a first-class offline tool-execution harness.** Verifying a new tool body
  required me to hand-roll importlib loading of tools.py + `AirlineTools(FlightDB.load(...))`
  against the tau2 venv, and to discover the correct venv/PYTHONPATH by trial (system
  python3 lacks tau2). A documented `scripts/verify_tool.py --tool NAME --args '{...}'`
  that loads the candidate tools and runs one body against the pristine DB would make the
  VERIFIED gate cheap and reproducible for every optimizer, instead of each rediscovering
  the environment plumbing.
- **Clarify the SAFE check needs the passing tasks' exact tool-call args.** The guidance
  says to re-run a guard on 1–2 passing tasks' args, but those args live inside the
  trajectory JSON (rollout messages), not in an easy-to-consume form. A small extractor
  that dumps "tool calls made by each passing task" would make the blast-radius check
  turnkey.
